s013 keeps a noun of its own ('way'), so rule 19's directional-construct rider does not apply and the relational 'of' goes to the rectum s015.
s002 'heard tell' is one verb's rendering headed on 'heard' by rule 31's subtraction; s007 is rule 41's articleless attributive recast as a relative.
